acceptance.guard_scope: Observed macro values, with paired uncertainty reported; no claim of strict population noninferiority or all operating points.

interpretation: MAP improvement plus nondegradation guards; fixed seeds and repeatedly developed synthetic valid only. No test access, no winner/seed selection, no claim of population noninferiority or continual improvement.

paired_primary.scope: Conditional on fixed models, seeds, generated data and thresholds; not training-seed population uncertainty.
paired_primary.unit: paired whole group within each domain; average fixed seeds before resampling

aggregation.initialization: Xavier hidden weight; hidden bias and output weight zero; local CPU RNG seed_for(initialization_seed,item_aggregation), shared RNG preserved.

policy.data_scope: Original expression data; unchanged partition seed 20260918, 48 fit/12 calibration/20 development groups per domain; masked title and description only, 27 within-group candidates.

evaluation.automatic_gate_role: Historical diagnostic only, never retrieval acceptance.
evaluation.nondegradation_scope: Observed group-macro values; report conditional paired intervals; not population noninferiority or all domains/operating points.

automatic_classification.interval_scope: Group bootstrap conditional on fixed models, calibration groups and thresholds; zero observed FP may produce [0,0], not a population upper bound or deployment guarantee.

fixed_classification.aggregation: Sum confusion counts before computing rates; distinct from mean per-group metrics.
